description: This file defines database migration scripts for an Android app using Room. It contains multiple migration objects for transitioning between database schema versions (1 to 4), including adding columns to existing tables and creating a new notifications preferences table with default entries.

classes.name: Migrations
classes.description: A singleton object encapsulating multiple Migration objects used to upgrade the database schema across different versions.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Overrides the migrate method to perform specific SQL commands for schema alterations during each migration step.
